newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Yates says first half was difficult.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Yates says first half was difficult.

text.p: Horticultural group Arthur Yates and Co Ltd said on Monday the 6.9 percent fall in net profit to A$4.20 million for the six months ended December 31, 1996 reflected a difficult retail market.

"The result confirms how difficult the retail market has been in the calendar year 1996 and whilst Yates has maintained its share of the gardening market in Australia, pressure on retail margins continues," chairman Stanley Howard said.
Howard said management was very focussed on delivering the cost savings flowing from operations changes, which were aimed at improving the return on shareholders investment.
Yates said improved gardening conditions provide the possibility of a better than normal autumn period for the second half.
However, whilst sales during January reached management targets, pressure on margins in the retail sector has continued. Yates shares closed one cent down at A$1.05 on Friday.
